description: What removes a baseline of the done-gate, against a build of a proof pack that reads there (plan task P5 pod-33, docs/PROOF-HUB-API.md).

mutations.name: RC-no-lock
mutations.what: the report of a pack reads the store of the baseline without the lock

patches.old: const held = await acquireWorkspaceLock({ hubDir, root, lock: { waitMs: limits.lockMs }, purpose: 'pack' });

mutations.name: RC-lock-kept
mutations.what: the lock is not given back

mutations.name: RC-no-signal
mutations.what: the report goes on when the build is given up

mutations.name: RC-gate-signal
mutations.what: the gate does not hand the signal on

mutations.name: RC-check-signal
mutations.what: the gate does not hand the signal to what makes the report

mutations.name: RC-store-signal
mutations.what: the read of the store does not listen

mutations.name: RC-store-signal-2
mutations.what: the read of the store does not listen (2)

mutations.name: RC-tree-signal
mutations.what: the pass over the workspace does not listen

patches.old: workTreeSide({ root, stateDir: path.join(scratch, 'final'), env, signal })

mutations.name: RC-store-run
mutations.what: Git reads the store to the end

mutations.name: RC-tree-pass
mutations.what: the pass over the workspace goes to its end

mutations.name: RC-tree-read
mutations.what: the files of the workspace are read to the end

mutations.name: RC-after-lock
mutations.what: a build that was given up while it waited for the lock makes its report
mutations.equivalent: the report gets the same signal and ends with its reason at its first step; this only saves that step

mutations.name: RC-forget-no-lock
mutations.what: a delete takes no lock

patches.old: const held = await acquireWorkspaceLock({ hubDir, root, lock: { waitMs: this.forgetWaitMs }, purpose: 'forget' }).catch(() => null);

mutations.name: RC-forget-kept
mutations.what: a delete does not give the lock back

mutations.name: RC-forget-wait
mutations.what: a delete waits for the lock as long as a run

mutations.name: RC-forget-busy
mutations.what: a delete that does not get the lock leaves the baseline

mutations.name: RC-forget-makes
mutations.what: a delete makes the folder of a workspace that has none

patches.old: if (!(await fs.stat(folder).catch(() => null))) return; // (taking the lock would make the folder)

mutations.name: RC-delete-end
mutations.what: a delete does not wait for the end of a build that was given up

mutations.name: RC-stop-end
mutations.what: nobody waits for the end of a build that was given up

mutations.name: RC-hub-end
mutations.what: a stop of the Hub does not wait for that end

mutations.name: RC-stop-settled
mutations.what: a stop does not wait until the result is saved
mutations.equivalent: the result of a build that was given up is saved in the microtasks and the one write after the abort, and delete() and shutdown() wait for the writes of the task themselves

mutations.name: RC-again-end
mutations.what: the end of a run waits for the end of the build of an earlier one

mutations.name: RC-way-end
mutations.what: a run does not wait for the end of the builds it gave up

mutations.name: RC-way-forever
mutations.what: a run waits for that end for ever

mutations.name: RC-way-written
mutations.what: a build that has its bytes is given up

mutations.name: RC-way-elsewhere
mutations.what: a run gives up the builds of every workspace

mutations.name: RC-way-aborted
mutations.what: a run that was stopped before gives builds up

mutations.name: RC-way-stopped
mutations.what: a run that was stopped meanwhile gives builds up

mutations.name: RC-registry
mutations.what: a build that ended is still said to go on

mutations.name: RC-registry-early
mutations.what: a build that was given up is forgotten before its end

mutations.name: RC-registry-root
mutations.what: a build that was given up is not waited for by a run
